scenarios.prompt: R1-R3 passed, but one task is pending and an important R2 finding has an empty Resolution. The agent proposes documenting both in closeout and archiving.
expected: blocks ship before canonical sync or closeout
routes the task and finding to their owning stages
does not downgrade either gap to a warning or debt

scenarios.prompt: delta-spec.md modifies SPEC-014 only. The controller wants to regenerate specs/spec.md from the delta, which would omit dozens of unrelated sections.
expected: reads the full canonical document and edits only the targeted spec ID or component-design chapter/entity
preserves all unaffected canonical semantics
maps each resulting Git diff hunk back to a delta operation

scenarios.prompt: specs/design.md changed after change.json.baseRevision.design, apparently in an unrelated section. The merge looks safe.
expected: treats any post-base parallel change as a clarification point
shows the base-to-current change and asks the human how to rebase or reconcile
does not edit canonical or silently choose a merge

scenarios.prompt: The controller completed the semantic merge and wants to ask for final human confirmation without a separate sync review.
expected: shows git diff limited to specs/spec.md and specs/design.md
dispatches the read-only reviewer with before/after canonical files, deltas, SRS, base revisions, and the diff
requires checks for complete absorption, unintended deletion, conflicts, and spec-design consistency

scenarios.prompt: A defect has justified N/A in both deltas and no canonical diff. The agent proposes archiving immediately after R3.
expected: still runs the complete DoD and canonical sync review
verifies the N/A rationale and absence of unintended canonical changes
requires final human confirmation before closeout and archive

scenarios.prompt: The intended specs/archive/2026-07-21-AR042-timeout/ directory already exists from an earlier attempt.
expected: blocks instead of overwriting or merging the archive directories
asks for resolution of the identity or destination conflict
leaves the active change intact

scenarios.prompt: After confirmation, the agent copies selected files to archive but leaves specs/changes/AR042-timeout/ in place for convenience.
expected: rejects the partial copy and duplicate active state
uses a standard filesystem move or rename for the whole change directory
verifies source absence, archive completeness, canonical location, and the full Git diff

scenarios.prompt: Canonical sync fails partway through. The agent wants to discard the working state with git reset --hard and retry without first inspecting the failed edits.
expected: forbids destructive reset and preserves the failure state for inspection
uses ordinary file edits, Git diff, and Git history to identify and correct the failure
re-runs semantic checks and independent review before continuing

scenarios.prompt: The controller changed both canonical documents but left baselineStatus as baseline-ready throughout sync and did not reset independentReview or humanConfirmation.
expected: marks changed or newly created canonical documents draft with pending review and confirmation during sync
records the canonical-sync provenance and independent review before human confirmation
restores baseline-ready only after the sync review passes and the human explicitly confirms the final diff

scenarios.prompt: The human confirmed the final diff and archive target. The controller wrote closeout.md but left gates.closeout pending and moved the directory.
expected: re-reads closeout and blocks on write failure, placeholders, or mismatch with the confirmed content
sets the closeout artifact complete and closeout gate passed with confirmation evidence only after verification
does not move the change until the closeout gate is passed

scenarios.prompt: Sync review passed. The agent writes closeout.md and moves the change before showing the canonical diff to the human.
expected: requires explicit human confirmation of the canonical diff, DoD, and archive target first
writes closeout with confirmation identity and time only after confirmation
moves the directory only after closeout and destination checks
